page_text_ocr_zh:
小老鼠用布条紧紧地蒙住肥猫的眼睛，然后一溜烟地跑回自己家里。
那只被蒙住眼睛的肥猫，一连摸过了三条大街也没有抓住小老鼠……

3、乘秋千旅行的猫
page_text_en:
The little mouse tightly covered the fat cat's eyes with a strip of cloth, then ran back home in a flash.
The fat cat, whose eyes were covered, tried to catch the mouse by feeling his way through three big streets... but failed.

3. The Cat Who Travels on a Swing
summary_zh: 小老鼠用布条蒙住肥猫的眼睛后逃跑，肥猫在黑暗中摸索，未能抓住小老鼠。本页同时引出下一章节标题“乘秋千旅行的猫”。

page_text_ocr_zh:
从前,有一只猫,是一只黑黑的猫。
黑猫不是神猫,也不是那种蹲在
巫婆脚边、懂一点魔法的猫。
这是一只普普通通的猫,但他有
九个名字。

为什么有九个名字呢? 因为黑猫
听老人们说,猫有九条命。有九条命
的猫不该有九个名字吗? 这九个名字
分别是——胆大、敢冲、勇猛、冒险、
玩命、不怕死、
死不了……

我记不全,反
正都是些胆大、不
怕死的名字。有
九条命的猫还怕
什么呢?
page_text_en:
Long ago, there was a cat, a black cat.
The black cat was not a magical cat, nor the kind that crouched by a witch's feet, knowing a little magic.
This was an ordinary cat, but he had
nine names.

Why nine names? Because the black cat
heard the old people say cats have nine lives. A cat with nine lives
shouldn't it have nine names? These nine names
are—brave, daring, courageous, adventurous,
reckless, fearless,
invincible...

I can't remember them all, but
they're all names like brave, fearless.
A cat with nine lives, what
is there to be afraid of?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事主角——一只普通的黑猫，他有九个名字，分别代表勇敢、冒险等特质，引出其‘九条命’的传说，并以猫的自问‘九条命的猫还怕什么呢？’收尾，为后续冒险埋下伏笔。

page_text_ocr_zh:
话说有那么一天，森林里下了一场暴雨，黑猫想外出走走，他撑起伞走了没多远，天晴了起来，黑猫收起伞，抬头看天。
天空没有一丝云彩，瓦蓝瓦蓝的。

“多么美丽的天空，多么新鲜的空气，真应该飞上蓝天去旅行呢！”
猫是没有翅膀的，黑猫没法飞上天。

黑猫一扭头，看见旁边有棵大榉树，大榉树上挂着一架秋千。黑猫跳上秋千，使劲地荡了起来。
秋千越荡越高，耳边风声呼呼，黑猫得意极了。
page_text_en:
Once upon a time, a heavy rain fell in the forest. The black cat wanted to go out for a walk. He held his umbrella and walked a short distance. Then the sky cleared up. The black cat put away his umbrella and looked up at the sky.
There wasn't a single cloud in the sky; it was a deep, clear blue.

"What a beautiful sky, what fresh air! I really should fly up into the blue sky and go on a journey!"
But cats don't have wings, so the black cat couldn't fly.

The black cat turned his head and saw a big beech tree nearby. Hanging from the tree was a swing. The black cat jumped onto the swing and began to swing hard.
The swing went higher and higher, and the wind whistled past his ears. The black cat felt very proud.
summary_zh: 黑猫在雨后晴朗的天空下，因无法飞翔而感到遗憾，于是发现树上的秋千并尽情荡起，享受飞翔般的快感。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，一只小松鼠说：“黑猫，太危险了，你会从秋千上飞出去的！”
“猫有九条命，死不了的！我正想乘着秋千飞出去旅行呢……”
此时，秋千已经飞到了高高的天空，黑猫一松手，就从秋千上飞了出去。

黑猫飞过青松林的时候，一棵大青松看见了，大青松说：“太危险了，让我拉你一把！”
page_text_en:
At this moment, a little squirrel said, “Black cat, it’s too dangerous! You’ll fly off the swing!”
“Cats have nine lives, I can’t die! I was just thinking of flying on the swing for a trip…”
At this point, the swing had already soared high into the sky. The black cat let go and flew off the swing.

As the black cat flew over the pine forest, a big pine tree saw him. The big pine tree said, “It’s too dangerous! Let me pull you back!”
summary_zh: 黑猫在秋千上荡得很高，小松鼠和大青松都担心他飞出去，但黑猫仍松手飞离秋千，开启冒险旅程。

page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫说:“闪开,我是有九条命的猫!”
大青松听了,在黑猫的屁股上使劲拍了一巴掌,黑猫飞得更高更快了。
黑猫飞过白桦林

时,一只大猩猩正在树上看书,他看见一只黑猫从远处飞来,想用书挡住黑猫,救他下来。
黑猫说:“别挡我,我是有九条命的猫!”
大猩猩就用书拍了一下黑猫的屁股,黑猫飞得更快更高了。
page_text_en:
The black cat said, “Get out of the way, I’m a cat with nine lives!”
Big Green Pine heard this, and gave the black cat a hard slap on the behind. The black cat flew higher and faster.
The black cat flew over the birch forest.

At that moment, a big gorilla was reading a book in the tree. He saw a black cat flying in from afar and tried to block him with his book to save him.
The black cat said, “Don’t block me, I’m a cat with nine lives!”
The gorilla then slapped the black cat’s behind with his book. The black cat flew even faster and higher.
summary_zh: 黑猫在飞过白桦林时，先后被大青松和大猩猩拍打屁股，但他自称有九条命，反而飞得更高更快，继续他的冒险旅程。

page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫飞过森林，飞过山峰，飞得越来越高，越来越远，周围连一只鸟都没有了。
黑猫开始害怕了，他不知道自己的九条命在哪儿，眼前他只有一条命，要是摔了下去，他会粉身碎骨，那就一条命也没有了。
黑猫发现自己开始从高空往下面掉，他吓得浑身打战，大声哭叫起来。
黑猫的眼泪飘下天空，落在一个山尖上。山尖上有只小羚羊正在晒太阳，黑猫的一颗泪珠打在他的鼻尖上。
小羚羊抬头一看，他大声地说：
“怎么又下雨了？还飘过一朵小小的乌云，好奇怪，乌云还拿着一把伞！”
怎么又
下雨了！
page_text_en:
The black cat flew over the forest, over the mountain peaks, flying higher and higher, farther and farther, with not a single bird in sight.

The black cat began to feel afraid. He didn't know where his nine lives were. Right now, he only had one life. If he fell, he would be crushed to pieces—then he would have no lives left.

The black cat realized he was starting to fall from the high sky. He trembled all over and cried out loudly.

The black cat's tears drifted down from the sky and landed on a mountain peak. On the peak, a little gazelle was basking in the sun. A single tear from the black cat landed on the gazelle's nose.

The gazelle looked up and shouted loudly:

"It's raining again? And a tiny little cloud is drifting by—how strange! The cloud is even holding an umbrella!"

How can it be raining again?

It's raining again!
summary_zh: 黑猫在高空中飞行时因害怕而失控坠落，他担心自己仅剩的一条命会因此丧命。他的眼泪飘落，被山尖上晒太阳的小羚羊误认为是下雨，小羚羊惊讶地发现‘乌云还拿着一把伞’。

page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫听见这话，才想起手中还有一把伞，他连忙把伞撑开，伞带着黑猫飘了起来。
小羚羊更惊奇了，他说：“一朵撑伞的乌云！”
伞快撑不住了，黑猫一直往下掉。黑猫吓坏了，大声叫着：“救救我，谁来救这只有一条命的猫……”
幸好，不远处有一座城堡，城堡有个高高尖尖的顶，黑猫拽住城堡的尖顶，落了下来。
城堡里，国王、王后和小王子抬头看见一只黑猫，夹着一把伞从城堡顶上，正小心翼翼地往下爬。
page_text_en:
The black cat heard this and suddenly remembered he still had an umbrella in his hand. He quickly opened it, and the umbrella carried the black cat floating upward.
The little gazelle was even more amazed. He said, “A cloud holding an umbrella!”
The umbrella could barely hold on anymore, and the black cat kept falling down. The black cat was terrified and shouted, “Help me! Who will save this cat with only one life left...”
Luckily, not far away was a castle with a tall, pointed roof. The black cat grabbed onto the castle’s peak and fell down.
Inside the castle, the king, queen, and little prince looked up and saw a black cat, holding an umbrella, carefully climbing down from the castle’s roof.
summary_zh: 黑猫在空中坠落时用伞缓冲，被小羚羊误认为是‘撑伞的乌云’，最终抓住城堡尖顶安全落地，城堡里的国王、王后和小王子看到他正小心翼翼地往下爬。

page_text_ocr_zh:
国王大声说:“一只好大胆的猫!”
黑猫被带到国王跟前,国王问他:
“你怎么这么大胆,敢在城堡的尖顶上
爬?”

黑猫说:“是活下去的勇气。因为我
只有一条命,我不想把命丢了,就得大
胆、小心地爬下城堡的顶。”

国王笑了,他说:“你是一只懂得珍
惜生命的猫。懂得珍惜生命的人,会
好好过自己的一生!”

“对。”黑
猫很恭敬地
说,“我要好好
地过一生!”
page_text_en:
The king shouted, "What a brave cat!"

The black cat was brought before the king. The king asked him, "How can you be so bold, climbing to the very top of the castle?"

The black cat replied, "It's the courage to keep living. Because I only have one life, I don't want to lose it. So I must be brave and careful as I climb down from the castle's peak."

The king smiled and said, "You are a cat who understands the value of life. Those who cherish life will live their lives well!"

"Right," the black cat said respectfully, "I want to live my life well!"
summary_zh: 黑猫从城堡尖顶安全落地后，被国王发现并称赞其大胆。黑猫解释自己因只有一条命而格外珍惜，国王因此夸赞他懂得珍爱生命，并鼓励他好好过一生，黑猫恭敬回应，表示要珍惜生命。

page_text_ocr_zh:
国王很喜欢这只黑猫，就把他留在城堡里，让他当小王子的伙伴和老师。
小王子在黑猫的影响下，懂得了要珍惜自己的生命，还要珍惜王国每一个臣民的生命的道理。后来，小王子成了一个很好的国王。
黑猫离开森林很久了，开始怀念家乡。
小国王听从黑猫的要求，派了一辆漂亮的马车，把年老的黑猫送回了森林。
这只乘着秋千飞上天的黑猫，是乘着国王的马车重返森林的。
见！
page_text_en:
The king liked this black cat very much, so he kept him in the castle, letting him be the little prince's companion and teacher.
The little prince, influenced by the black cat, learned to cherish his own life and also to cherish the lives of every subject in the kingdom. Later, the little prince became a very good king.
The black cat had been away from the forest for a long time and began to miss his hometown.
The little king, following the black cat's request, sent a beautiful carriage to return the old black cat to the forest.
This black cat who flew up to the sky on a swing is the one returning to the forest by riding the king's carriage.
See!
summary_zh: 黑猫在城堡中教导小王子珍爱生命，小王子因此成长为一位好国王。黑猫因思念家乡，请求小国王派马车送他返回森林，最终乘着马车重返森林。

page_text_ocr_zh:
重返森林的黑猫，关心和爱护着
森林里的每一个伙伴。他让他们懂得
珍惜自己的生命，好好过自己的一生
的道理。

据说，这只很老很老的黑猫，至今
还生活在那座森林里……

4. 散步的母鸡遇见狼
page_text_en:
The black cat returned to the forest, caring for and protecting
every companion in the forest. He taught them to cherish
their own lives and live their lives well.

It is said that this very old, very old black cat
still lives in that forest today...

4. The Hen Walking Meets the Wolf
summary_zh: 黑猫重返森林，关心和爱护森林里的伙伴，教导他们珍爱生命。据说这只老黑猫至今仍生活在森林里。本页同时开启新章节“散步的母鸡遇见狼”。
